en: Vintage sepia postcard showing a riverside industrial and residential area in a valley with a weir and small bridge across the river. On the slopes above stand large historic buildings and a small church on the right. The printed title at the top identifies the scene as Bautzen and the Seidauer Spree bridge with the weir and Hammermühle (hammer mill). Several buildings bear signs, including one for a bicycle works and another labeled Hammermühle. Publisher information is printed vertically along the right edge.
